# DesktopAppShell

Organizes the desktop IM as a three pane AppLayout (navigation, primary, content, and detail panes); keyboard commands reach the host through one command event.

## Composition

Compose public components and contracts; see [DesktopAppShell](/en/components/desktop-app-shell).

## States

Cover loading, empty, error, offline, permission, and recovery. Focus enters the new task heading after pane transitions.

## Responsive

Wide screens preserve context; compact widths use a drawer, sheet, overlay, or route.
